subject: Three product questions for Profile v2
body: 1) Is 'leverage' (one line on why each emotion matters) in the MVP profile? Plan: optional field. 2) May a draft profile have fewer than three emotions? Plan: no, always three, drafts marked by status and confirmedAt null. 3) Profiles and rep logs stay in the browser only, with a JSON export? Plan: yes. Also please accept or reject D-contracts-003 and D-contracts-004 once onboarding, sensing and reps have weighed in.
